title: 2 Chronicles
author: Traditionally associated with Ezra or the Chronicler.
date: Written after the exile to instruct and encourage the restored community.
audience: The returned community of Israel, calling them to seek the Lord and worship faithfully.
historicalSetting: Second Chronicles focuses on Solomon, the temple, and the kings of Judah, highlighting revival, failure, judgment, and hope after exile.
keyVerse: 2 Chronicles 7:14 — "If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves... then I will hear from heaven."
christFocus: The temple and Davidic line point to Christ, who fulfills God's presence among His people and reigns as the promised King.
